'''Eskel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Carrick Station]], he owned a small shop where he bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
